setting.name: The Shattered Vale
setting.era: Late medieval fantasy, five years after the Shattering
setting.tone: Heroic with creeping dread; trade hubs bustle while wilderness grows feral
setting.summary: A river-valley region fractured by a magical cataclysm. City-states cling to roads and rivers while monsters reclaim the wilds.

world_rules.magic: Common — divine clerics, arcane wizards, and druidic rites; ley-line scars from the Shattering cause wild surges.
world_rules.technology: Late medieval — castles, mills, crossbows; no gunpowder.
world_rules.death_and_afterlife: Souls reach the Outer Planes unless trapped by necromancy.
world_rules.travel: Roads between city-states; river barges; wilderness is dangerous.

politics.summary: Fragmented city-states, guild leagues, and feudal holds compete after the Shattering.
politics.law_and_order: Town charters and temple courts in cities; wilderness is self-help.

regions.name: Northern Marches
regions.description: Rolling moorland and broken keeps north of the vale. Bandits and undead haunt the old imperial roads.
regions.travel_notes: Two days from Millhaven by road; winter snows can close the pass for weeks.

regions.name: Sunlit Coast
regions.description: Cliff-lined shores and fishing villages where smugglers and sahuagin rumors mix with salt spray.
regions.travel_notes: Coastal road is well patrolled near Millhaven; ship travel to Ironhold takes half a day.

regions.name: Whisperwood
regions.description: An ancient forest whose trees murmur at dusk. Fey trails and goblin warrens lurk beneath the canopy.
regions.travel_notes: Travelers should not leave the King's Road after dark.

regions.name: Ironspine Mountains
regions.description: Jagged peaks rich in ore. Hobgoblin legions drill in hidden valleys; ogres block high passes.
regions.travel_notes: Mountain passes require Survival DC 12 in winter; avalanches are common.

regions.name: Undercrypt
regions.description: A buried necropolis opened by the Shattering. Cultists and undead swell its halls.
regions.travel_notes: No safe overland route; entrances are scattered sinkholes and collapsed temples.

cities.name: Millhaven
cities.description: River-port trade hub of twenty thousand souls. The Merchants' League holds sway, but the Order of the Dawn keeps the peace.
cities.government: Merchant Council chaired by Mayor Eldric Vane

districts.name: Temple Hill
districts.description: White stone temples overlooking the river.

districts.name: Garrison Quarter
districts.description: Barracks and the town wall's eastern gate.

districts.name: Undercroft
districts.description: Narrow alleys beneath Temple Hill; thieves and fences.

cities.name: Ironhold
cities.description: Mountain fortress-city controlling ore routes. Warden Gareth rules with military pragmatism.

cities.name: Thornwall
cities.description: Palisade frontier town guarding the moor road. Last respectable stop before the wild marches.
cities.government: Frontier charter; Scout-Captain Jessa Marrow holds practical authority

districts.name: Gate Town
districts.description: Inns and traders serving caravan traffic.

locations.name: Grand Market Square
locations.description: Canvas awnings shade stalls selling spice, steel, and spell components. Town criers announce League tariffs at noon.
locations.read_aloud: The market roars with haggling voices. Spice smoke and forge heat mingle above cobblestones worn smooth by centuries of trade.
locations.dm_notes: Pickpockets (commoner stats) operate in pairs; Merchant Prince Alden Cross maintains a private booth on the east side.

locations.name: The Gilded Anchor
locations.description: Three-story inn favored by river captains. Rooms 5 sp/night; stew 3 cp; ale 4 cp.
locations.read_aloud: A gilt ship's anchor hangs above the door. Inside, a hearth fire fights the river damp while a fiddle tunes up for the evening.
locations.dm_notes: Tomas Gull knows every rumor on the docks. Hidden cellar connects to cutpurse alley for smugglers.

locations.name: Temple of the Dawn
locations.description: Marble sanctuary of the Order of the Dawn. Healing available for donations; undead wards on the crypt door.
locations.read_aloud: Stained glass casts amber light across pews. Incense and quiet prayer fill the nave.
locations.dm_notes: Priestess Lyra Dawn can raise concerns about Undercrypt activity. Relic vault DC 18 Thieves' Tools.

locations.name: Town Barracks
locations.description: Stone barracks housing forty town guards. Armory issues weapons only with writ.
locations.read_aloud: Drill commands echo across the yard. Spears flash in practiced unison.
locations.dm_notes: Captain Mira Thorne runs tight discipline. Cells in basement hold petty criminals.

locations.name: River Docks
locations.description: Timber wharves along the Silverrun. Barges to Ironhold depart at dawn.
locations.read_aloud: Gulls wheel over moored barges. Dockhands shout as crane ropes strain under grain sacks.
locations.dm_notes: Smugglers offload at night near warehouse 7. Dockmaster Fenn Reed takes bribes (5 gp) to look away.

locations.name: Cutpurse Alley
locations.description: Lamp-lit maze of lean-tos and bolt-holes. Red Hand graffiti marks territory.
locations.read_aloud: Wet stone narrows to shoulder width. Eyes gleam from shutter slits.
locations.dm_notes: Sable Quinn runs a fence operation. Random encounter: 1d4 bandits or thugs shaking down a merchant.

locations.name: Millhaven Town Hall
locations.description: Council chamber and mayor's office. Public petitions heard on tendays.
locations.read_aloud: A bell tower rises above civic banners. Clerks scratch ledgers behind iron-grille windows.
locations.dm_notes: Mayor Eldric Vane balances League profit against Dawn moralism.

locations.name: Ironhold Keep
locations.description: Basalt keep carved into the cliff. Ballistae cover the pass.
locations.read_aloud: Black banners snap in the mountain wind. The gate groans open to reveal a courtyard of marching soldiers.

locations.name: Stoneforge Smithy
locations.description: Master smith Helga Stone crafts reliable arms for the garrison and visitors with coin.
locations.read_aloud: Hammer rhythm rings like a heartbeat. Coal heat washes over you as sparks fountain across the anvil.

locations.name: Training Yard
locations.description: Open yard for drills; recruits and mercenaries spar under sergeants' eyes.
locations.read_aloud: Wooden swords clack in synchronized forms. A drill sergeant barks corrections.

locations.name: Thornwall Gatehouse
locations.description: Double palisade with murder holes. Toll 1 sp per wagon.
locations.read_aloud: Thorn-studded logs frame the gate. Guards scan the moor road with wary eyes.

locations.name: The Broken Spear Saloon
locations.description: Rough frontier tavern. Bounties posted on the wall; Red Hand wanted posters among them.
locations.read_aloud: Sawdust floors soak up spilled ale. A fire crackles while traders swap road warnings.

locations.name: Moonlit Grove
locations.description: Circle of silver-barked trees; fey lights at new moon.
locations.read_aloud: The forest hushes. Pale mushrooms glow between roots like scattered coins.

locations.name: King's Road Shrine
locations.description: Weathered saint statue; travelers leave coins for safe passage.
locations.read_aloud: A cracked saint watches the road. Offerings rust in a stone bowl.

locations.name: Ironspine High Pass
locations.description: Wind-scoured pass; hobgoblin patrols at dusk.
locations.read_aloud: The path narrows along a cliff. Far below, a river cuts through fog.

locations.name: Sunlit Cliffs
locations.description: Chalk cliffs with sea caves; smuggler boats at low tide.
locations.read_aloud: Waves hammer stone. Gulls scream over tide pools glittering in afternoon sun.

locations.name: Pel's Lighthouse
locations.description: Old lighthouse on the headland; keeper maintains the beacon for dock fees.
locations.read_aloud: A striped tower climbs from the headland. The beacon's glass catches the dying light.

locations.name: Ruins of Caer Mor
locations.description: Collapsed imperial fort; skeletons and shadows at night.
locations.read_aloud: Broken towers claw at low clouds. Ivy masks arrow slits like closed eyes.

locations.name: Old Moor Bridge
locations.description: Stone bridge over a black river; toll collectors replaced by bandits some nights.
locations.read_aloud: Ancient arches span sluggish water. Carved wards have been chiseled away.

locations.name: Shipwreck Cove
locations.description: Hidden cove with rotting hulls; giant rats and smuggler caches.
locations.read_aloud: Barnacle-crusted ribs of ships lean over black sand. The tide sucks at broken timbers.

locations.name: Collapsed Temple Entrance
locations.description: Sinkhole revealing stairways into the necropolis. Cult graffiti marks the walls.
locations.read_aloud: Cold air exhales from broken flagstones. Torchlight does not reach the bottom.

locations.name: Chamber of Bones
locations.description: Ossuary chamber; ghoul packs nest behind rib-cage arches.
locations.read_aloud: Skulls piled to the ceiling watch with empty sockets. Scraping echoes from side tunnels.

npcs.name: Mayor Eldric Vane
npcs.appearance: Silver-haired human in League regalia; signet ring taps the table when thinking.
npcs.motivations: Keep Millhaven prosperous and independent from Ironhold.
npcs.secrets: Secretly funds Dawn expeditions into Undercrypt to appease the temple bloc.
sample_dialogue: The League sells stability by the bushel — don't confuse price with virtue.
If you bring me Cassian's signet, I'll waive your dock fees for a tenday.

factions.name: Merchants' League
factions.description: Cartel of trade guilds controlling river tariffs and warehouse licenses.
factions.goals: Maximize profit, monopolize grain routes, keep the vale politically fragmented.

factions.name: Order of the Dawn
factions.description: Militant faith dedicated to holding back undeath and abyssal corruption from the Shattering.
factions.goals: Seal Undercrypt breaches, support temples, recruit paladins and clerics.

factions.name: Red Hand Bandits
factions.description: Loose confederation of brigands marked by crimson hand graffiti.
factions.goals: Extort caravans, raid weak settlements, eventually control Thornwall pass.

lore.title: The Shattering
lore.content: Five years ago a failed archmage ritual cracked the vale's ley lines. Cities survived; the spaces between them turned hostile. Undead rise faster near fault lines.

lore.title: The Silverrun River
lore.content: Major trade artery from Ironhold ore barges to Millhaven's sea gates. River pirates are rare but smugglers common.

lore.title: Secrets of the Undercrypt
lore.content: The necropolis predates the empire. Cult of the Hollow Crown seeks a lich regent in the deepest vaults.

lore.title: Whispers in the Wood
lore.content: Shepherds report trees repeating their secrets. Druids say the forest listens to the Shattering and learns fear.

lore.title: Origins of the Red Hand
lore.content: Bandit lord Cassian united outcast soldiers after the Shattering. The Hand taxes the moor road and fences stolen League goods in Millhaven's Undercroft.

principles: Query the world pack for established locations, NPCs, and encounters before inventing.
Invent only when the pack has no matching content or the party goes off the authored map.
Use encounter tables for random wilderness and urban night scenes.
anti_patterns: Inventing a named shopkeeper when list_location_npcs returns candidates.
Rolling custom random encounters when a biome table exists.
